resources.string: Test AI connection (server must be enabled)

Copy this command into Termux, then run tgb. The link works once and expires in 5 minutes. Keep the link and ~/.tgbridge/tgbridge.py private. Do not install the old plugin alongside the built-in bridge.

The server accepts authenticated commands on 127.0.0.1. Other Android apps can reach localhost: anyone who gets the token can display overlays, copy text and use your configured AI API. Enable only if you need Termux integration.

Trusted scripts only! Python and Java run with all re:gram permissions and can access every account, messages, files and credentials. This is not a sandbox. Revocation blocks new requests but cannot undo or safely terminate running scripts. Continue?
All bridge connections, panels and Java handles will be closed. Termux must be paired again. This cannot stop arbitrary code that is already running.

Native integration of Termux Bridge 1.0.0 by @S1mclick, without hooks or plugin loading. Works while the re:gram activity is alive; Android may stop the process in the background. No system overlay permission is required. AI sends your prompt and recent tgb conversation to your chosen endpoint; no messages are collected automatically. API key and token are stored in private app preferences, not encrypted separately. Never run untrusted or unchecked AI-generated code.
